title: Elixir of Viciousness

sources.title: Elixir of Viciousness
markers: * The number you need to roll to land a [[Critical Hit]] is reduced by 1.

sources.title: Elixirs
markers: Only one elixir can be applied at a time

summary: Drink as a Bonus Action. Reduce the roll required for a critical hit by 1, stacking with other threshold reductions until the next Long Rest.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Reduce the roll required for a critical hit by 1, stacking with other threshold reductions until the next Long Rest.
fields.Stacking: Replaces another elixir effect. Drinking a different elixir can end this effect early.
fields.Creative use: Drink before a fight where this effect will matter.
fields.Crafting: Combine Vitriol of Shadowroot Sac with any Ashes.
fields.Base value: 50 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 activation, effects and linked rules.
